nodes.label: Case Detail Modal – Distribuidora Nexo Comercial (En revisión)
nodes.description: UI screenshot of a case/lead detail modal for 'Distribuidora Nexo Comercial S.A.P.I. de C.V.' in the Captio platform (Spanish). Shows a status workflow bar with stages: Invitado, Nuevo, En revisión (currently selected/active), Consulta agendada, Revisión de conflicto, Cliente aceptado, Rechazado, Cerrado. Below the status bar is a section titled 'Respuestas del cliente' (Client Responses) with a prominent 'Generar resumen' (Generate summary) CTA button and an 'Eliminar' (Delete) button. A subsection 'Información básica' is partially visible. Category label reads 'Negocios / contrato' (Business / contract).
nodes.ui_purpose: Case management detail view with status tracking and client response review
